title: Ghibli Anime Portrait: The Niji 6 Guide
description: How to nail Ghibli / Shinkai / Demon Slayer style in MJ Niji 6. The secret: anchor to specific works + use color terms + lens terms.

prompt.main: anime girl in traditional japanese kimono with cherry blossom pattern, standing under a thousand-year sakura tree, petals falling in the wind, golden hour light filtering through branches, hayao miyazaki style, studio ghibli color palette, hand-painted texture, watercolor background, soft focus --niji 6 --ar 3:4

explained.why: MJ's anime-optimized model. ~50% better at anime than v6.
Vertical aspect ratio for portraits and posters.
Anchor to a specific artist. Beats generic "anime style" by a mile. MJ has a unique reading of miyazaki.

tutorial.intro: Niji 6 is MJ's best mode for anime. Master the "work name + color + lens" trio and you'll get Ghibli / Shinkai / Demon Slayer style reliably.
steps: Work anchor: "hayao miyazaki style" / "makoto shinkai style" / "demon slayer style" is 10x stronger than just "anime".
Subject layer: anime girl in traditional japanese kimono with cherry blossom pattern — subject + clothing + pattern.
Environment layer: standing under a thousand-year sakura tree, petals falling in the wind — scene + motion.
Lighting layer: golden hour light filtering through branches — Ghibli's signature golden hour.
Texture layer: hand-painted texture, watercolor background, soft focus — Ghibli's hand-painted + watercolor look.
tutorial.tips: Niji 6 beats v6 on character and hair detail. For "Shinkai style" (hyperreal light), use v6 + "makoto shinkai" prompt instead — Niji softens it too much.

crossModel.midjourney: Niji 6 mode, --ar 3:4, --s 100 (low stylize preserves the painterly feel).
crossModel.flux: Flux anime is OK but the SD ecosystem is richer. Prompt: "Anime girl in kimono under sakura tree, Ghibli style, hand-painted watercolor"
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3 anime is weaker than MJ Niji 6 and SD ecosystem.
crossModel.jimeng_zh: 日系软萌动漫少女，白色猫耳，金色眼睛，粉色卫衣，窗台，日落，茶杯，新海诚光线

faq.q: Niji 6 vs MJ v6 for anime?
faq.a: Niji 6 wins on pure anime and 2D style. v6 is better for "Shinkai-style" hyperreal light scenarios.
Use MJ v6 (not niji) + "makoto shinkai style" + "cinematic lighting, hyper detailed sky".

faq.q: Why can't I get a Ghibli look?
faq.a: You must write "hayao miyazaki" or "studio ghibli" explicitly. "anime" alone is too vague — MJ doesn't know which sub-school you want.
